Card Q&A.q: Can I use  on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Starmons] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when this card itself is played?

Effect: This card is also treated as [Starmons] for DigiXros.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Xros Heart] trait Digimon are played, until the end of your opponent's turn, give 1 of their Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ and it gets -3000 DP.
[On Deletion] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has the [Xros Heart] trait, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
